Durante quarenta anos a gestão coordenou: For forty years, management coordinated two things: people and processes. Now a third has arrived, and it works alongside your team. In this lesson you walk through the five eras of management, see what each one added, and find out why 2027 is not about creating agents, but about answering for them.

A gestão de pessoas organizou o trabalho: People management organized work into roles: each with responsibility, tools, limits and evaluation. Who gives a discount, up to how much, who double-checks. That logic hasn't gone away: almost everything you will do with agents comes from it.
Depois a empresa aprendeu a desenhar, do: Then companies learned to design, document, train for and run processes. The process became an asset: you can teach it to newcomers and hold the people who run it accountable. The risk of this era is treating the process as something that can't be touched.
A transformação digital automatizou o qu: Digital transformation automated what was already designed: design, automate, monitor. Systems carry out fixed steps; when something falls outside the rule, they stop and wait for a person.
Em 2025 e 2026 a pergunta foi como criar: In 2025 and 2026 the question was how to create agents: prompts, skills, context, tools, memory. Many companies learned to build an agent in an afternoon. Few learned what to do with it the next day.
Em 2027 a empresa coordena ao mesmo temp: In 2027 the company coordinates humans, agents, models, processes and compute budget all at once. The question changes from "how do I build it?" to "who answers for it, what does it do on its own, how do I know it's good and how much does each result cost?".
Pessoas, processos, digital, construção: People, processes, digital, building and management. The last era uses all the earlier ones: the role comes from people management, the design comes from process management, the measure comes from digital. What it adds is a new worker, who needs a boss.
Five eras; the last one coordinates them all.
As datas das eras são aproximadas e vêm: The dates of the eras are approximate and come from the INEMA AI Management Area; they are meant to give you a sense of place, not to set a calendar.

Qualquer equipe monta um agente numa tar: Any team can build an agent in an afternoon. What holds the company back is what comes after: who answers for it, what it can do on its own, how you measure whether it's good and how much each result costs.
These four questions aren't technical. They're the same ones a manager asks when a new employee arrives, and nobody expects IT to answer for them.

Colocar um agente num fluxo desenhado pa: Putting an agent into a flow designed for people fifteen years ago only delivers the error faster. The question that changes everything: if I had humans, agents and automations today, would this process still exist this way?

A Hora entrou no mesmo caminho de antes:: Hora went down the same path as before: it notes the order, sends it to the warehouse and someone checks it later, if there's time. Only now it's hundreds of conversations a week.
Com agentes medindo a própria execução,: With agents measuring their own execution, the process becomes a living system: it runs, observes, proposes an improvement, tests, validates and promotes. INEMA calls this cycle LOOP-R, and it is the subject of the G5 course.

O cargo dizia para que a pessoa estava a: The job told you what the person was there for. For the agent, the role is a sentence with process and result, written down, because it does not pick up the job in the hallway. In G3 this becomes the digital role job sheet.
A responsabilidade da pessoa vira o obje: The person's responsibility becomes the agent's goal: the result you check. With one difference that does not change: responsibility for the result stays with a person, by name.
Pessoa aprende o contexto convivendo: sa: A person learns context by being around: they know that client pays late, that the price list changed yesterday. The agent only knows what it receives in writing. Explicit context is one of the two items that people management did not have.
A pessoa recebia acesso ao sistema, ao t: A person got access to the system, the phone, the spreadsheet. An agent gets tools that act: look up, create, send, delete. Each one is a management decision, not just an IT one.
Limite de pessoa era combinado e crescia: A person's limit was agreed on and grew with trust over the years. For an agent, autonomy is graduated and written action by action: what it does on its own, what it prepares for approval, what it never does. This is the second new item.
A avaliação de desempenho continua, só q: Performance review continues, only with more measurement: an agent can be measured on almost everything (accuracy, time, cost, rework, how many times it needed a person). An error becomes a corrected instruction and a test case.

A Patrícia virou chefe da Hora sem ningu: Patrícia became Hora's boss without anyone telling her. She already knew how to manage Juliana; she just hadn't written down for Hora what she would say to a new saleswoman.
Na contabilidade, separação de funções,: In accounting, separation of duties, authority limits and human review have always applied to the assistant. They apply the same way to the agent: it goes up to the door of the signature, never past it.
Isso não é desconfiança do agente. É a m: This isn't distrust of the agent. It's the same rule that protects the company from any error, human or not.
A Hora registra o pedido. Pedido acima d: Hora records the order. An order above R$ 5 thousand only goes to picking with Patrícia's approval (fictional study policy).
No jurídico, o agente faz a primeira lei: In legal work, the agent does the first read and the lawyer decides and signs: responsibility isn't delegated, it's organized. In health care, the administrative side can go to AI, but some decisions stay outside the agent's authority limit.
Nos dois casos o limite é uma decisão de: In both cases the limit is a management decision, made before turning the agent on, not after the first scare.
Desconto até 5% a Hora dá sozinha a clie: Hora gives a discount of up to 5% on its own to a registered customer. From 5% to 10%, it prepares and Patrícia decides. Above that, it doesn't even offer.
Uma pessoa tem necessidades, direitos e: A person has needs, rights and relationships; you talk with them, and you look after their workload and their future. An agent is managed by performance, reliability and security. With an agent, you want to know how many deliveries came out right.
O erro também muda: com a pessoa, vira c: Error changes too: with a person, it becomes a conversation and learning; with an agent, it becomes a corrected instruction and a new test case. The serious mistake is mixing the two up.
Desde que a Hora chegou, a Juliana respo: Since Hora arrived, Juliana answers only what Hora doesn't know. Patrícia measures Hora by accuracy; with Juliana, she talks about what changed in her work.

Primeiro o resultado, depois a ferrament: Result first, tool second. Don't start with the model or the platform. This is the skill for this course (G0): knowing what you want before you turn anything on.
Arquitetura do trabalho: eliminar, simpl: Work architecture: eliminate, simplify, redesign, and only then automate. Step by step, decide what is a person, an agent, a simple automation, or nothing. This is the G2 course.
Objetivo, responsabilidade, contexto, fe: Objective, responsibility, context, tools, deadline, and evidence of completion. Delegating means handing the agent work it can finish and you can check. This is the G3 course.
Um agente ou vários, em série ou em para: One agent or several, in series or in parallel, with a person in the middle, a supervisor agent, or a reviewer. Split only when there is a signal for it. Also in the G3 course.
Permissões, identidade, credenciais, reg: Permissions, identity, credentials, records, and traceability. Authority limits before autonomy: what the agent does alone, what it confirms, and what it never executes. This is the G5 course.
Modelo, tokens, tempo, infraestrutura: c: Model, tokens, time, infrastructure: cost per run, per task, and per result. A cheap agent that makes mistakes and needs two tries cost double the price list. This is the G4 course.
Qualidade, tempo, custo, falhas, retraba: Quality, time, cost, failures, rework, autonomy, human intervention, and business results, always compared to a starting point. An agent gets a performance review. This is the G5 course.
A empresa deixa de perguntar só \"a tare: The company stops asking only "did the task finish?" and starts asking what it learned from it. A tested improvement is promoted; one that made things worse is reverted. This is LOOP-R, in the G5 course.
